artworks.title: Two Nezperce Warriors and a Boy
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: Three figures stand side by side in an outdoor setting. The person on the left is facing forward, holding a shield. They have long dark hair with feathers and wear a fringed outfit. The central figure also faces forward, wearing a similar fringed outfit with long dark hair and a feathered headpiece. The person on the right stands with arms under a blanket adorned with a circular emblem, appearing wrapped warmly. The background shows a gradient sky transitioning from blue to yellow and green, suggesting an open landscape with light grass.

artworks.title: Antelope Shooting - Assinneboine
artworks.medium: oil on canvas
artworks.description: The painting depicts a landscape with a grassy terrain and a sky filled with soft brushstrokes blending hues of blue and grey. An individual is shown aiming a rifle at a herd of deer, with the deer appearing poised to flee. In the background, there are trees with foliage in various shades of green and subtle red highlights. The color palette consists of harmonious tones of greens, browns, blues, and greys.

artworks.title: A Cheyenne Chief, His Wife, and a Medicine Man
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing side by side on a grassy landscape. The central figure is holding a stick and wearing a garment with intricate patterns. They have long hair with feathers, a prominent nose, and full lips. The person on the left is wrapped in a patterned robe and has feathers in their hair. The individual on the right wears a fringed dress with circular patterns, long flowing hair, and a steady gaze. All three wear wrist bands or bracelets. The background has soft pastel hues depicting a sky and earthy tones for the surroundings.

artworks.title: Three Cheyenne Warriors
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three men standing in full-length positions. They are facing forward, with two standing in neutral poses and the man in the center in a more dynamic stance. All three men have long dark hair with feathers in their hairstyles and strong facial features with prominent cheekbones. They are wearing traditional indigenous clothing with minimal coverage and decorative elements like body paint. The men are carrying cultural objects: a bow, shields, and quivers with arrows. They also wear jewelry such as necklaces. The background features an outdoor setting with an earthy ground and a sky transitioning from blue to a light cloudy hue.

artworks.title: Cheyenne Village
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a painting of a camp with tipis. The image shows several conical tents made of animal hide, supported on wooden poles. The tipis are decorated with symbols and designs. In front of the tipis, there is a group of people engaged in different activities. The scene is set in an open grassy area with trees in the background under a sky with a mixture of blue and subtle cloud cover. A horizontal pole runs in front of the tipis. The colors used are earth tones. The overall style is detailed and illustrative.

artworks.title: A Cheyenne Warrior Resting His Horse
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing beside a black horse. The person has long dark hair with feathers, wearing skin trousers, moccasins, a quiver, and a bow slung across their back. They also have a blanket on the horse, a necklace, and a bracelet. The horse is decorated with a colorful cloth and feathers. The background shows an open landscape with a pale blue sky and light foliage on flat terrain.

artworks.title: Facsimile of a Cheyenne Robe
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a painting of scenes depicting Indigenous life and warfare. The imagery is composed within a textured border resembling an animal hide or parchment. The upper left shows two teepees with small human figures nearby, including some on horseback engaged in different activities. To the right, figures on horses are in conversation with a group standing close by. Below, figures seem to be interacting or struggling, with some mounted and others on foot. In the middle, two rows of figures appear to be marching or moving in a procession. At the bottom, groups are seen in a dance or ritual, depicted with dynamic postures. The background and border maintain an earthy, muted color palette, giving an aged or historical appearance. This is in the style of James Otto Lewis, known for documenting Native American cultures and scenes during the 19th century.

artworks.title: A Small Cheyenne Village
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene framed in an oval shape. The view includes a native encampment with conical structures scattered across a grassy field. A hill in the background slopes gently upwards towards the horizon. The painting features smooth brushstrokes and realistic yet softly idealized vegetation and sky. The color palette consists of warm greens, browns, and earthy tones for the land, while the sky transitions from light blue to soft peach. In the distance, gentle hills fade into the background under a tranquil sky. The oval frame and muted border add to the serene quality of the scene.

artworks.title: The Cheyenne Brothers Starting on Their Fall Hunt
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees, hills, and mountains under a partly cloudy sky. In the foreground, there is a tipi surrounded by figures dressed in traditional attire interacting with a horse. More figures and animals are spread throughout the scene. The painting has smooth brushstrokes and detailed elements, with tones of green, brown, blue, and white dominating.

artworks.title: The Cheyenne Brothers Returning from Their Fall Hunt
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with broken tree trunks and poles in the foreground, suggesting remnants of a structure. In the distance, there are hills with scattered trees under a sky with clouds. Birds are flying among the trees. Several figures on horseback are gesturing and pointing towards something, appearing to be in motion through the grassy terrain. The scene is depicted with smooth brushstrokes and a color palette of earthy tones, balanced by the soft blue sky.

artworks.title: Four Kiowa Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard

artworks.title: Kiowa Chief, His Wife, and Two Warriors
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows four people standing in a row. The first person on the left wears a knee-length skirt and necklaces. The next person has long dark hair, wears arm and neck bands, and holds a weapon. The third person has hair with feathers, wears a tasseled and beaded outfit, and holds a club. The fourth person has long, dark hair with a feather, carries a bow and arrow, and has a shield. All individuals are barefoot and wear fringed garments. The background is a neutral color with hints of green.

artworks.title: Kiowa Indians Gathering Wild Grapes
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene from an elevated viewpoint, showing a sunlit landscape with people engaged in various activities. The horizon meets a calm, clear sky with soft blues and tinted clouds. Tall trees, detailed with textured brushstrokes, stand at the center. The color palette is warm and earthy, dominated by greens, browns, and yellows. In the distance, a line of faded trees leads the eye to the horizon, creating a serene atmosphere that captures the simplicity of rural life.

artworks.title: Camanchee Chief, His Wife, and a Warrior
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: Three individuals are standing on a grassy area. The person on the left is holding a bow and shield with feathers, wearing a fringed garment and tall moccasins. In the center, a person with long dark hair and a richly decorated robe stands. On the right, a person with a child on their back wears a fringed dress and holds a feathered object. The background is a light-colored backdrop with a hint of blue.

artworks.title: Camanchee Chief with Three Warriors
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals, three seated on the ground and one standing slightly to the left. They are shown from head to toe. The seated individuals are positioned side by side on what appears to be animal hides or garments, while the standing person holds a bow. They have dark hair adorned with feathers and wear traditional clothing with patterns, fringed elements, and body paint. The person on the left has a sash across their chest. Two white horses are positioned behind them. The scene is set on a grassy plain with a light blue sky in the background.

artworks.title: Camanchee Chief's Children and Wigwam
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows five individuals standing in front of a tepee. An adult woman is at the center, flanked by two young boys. Another child is partly hidden behind the woman. To the right, a small child interacts with a dog. The group stands in a grassy area under a sky with soft clouds, near a decorated tepee.

artworks.title: Sham Fight of the Camanchees
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals on horseback in a lively scene. The sky meets a line of trees, with teepees nestled within them. The brushstrokes are detailed, with precise lines defining the horses and riders. The sky has blue and gray hues with clouds. The grassy terrain is depicted in green and yellow tones.

artworks.title: Camanchee Horsemanship
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals on horseback in a landscape with hills in the distance. The perspective is from above, providing a panoramic view of the scene. The horizon is positioned a third of the way down from the top, dividing the land from the sky. The painting features detailed brushstrokes capturing the motion of the horses and riders. The color palette includes earthy tones with bright accents. The scene conveys movement and interaction between the riders and their surroundings.

artworks.title: Battle between the Jiccarilla Apachees and Camanchees
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying on the grass reaching out toward an object, while others on horses gallop across a grassy expanse. In the background, there are trees and a sky painted with soft colors. The color palette includes natural tones, with greens, browns, and various colored cloaks worn by the figures.

artworks.title: Camanchees Moving
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a wide view over a grassy plain, with a high horizon line and groups of figures and horses in the distance. Close by, numerous people, most on horseback, engage in coordinated activities. They wear traditional clothing and appear to be involved in a hunt. The painting features fine, detailed brushstrokes and a color palette of green, brown, red, and earth tones, under a sky of soft blues and grays with scattered clouds.

artworks.title: Defile of a Camanchee War Party
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene with an elevated perspective overlooking a vast landscape. The horizon is positioned in the upper third of the image with trees fading into the distance. In the foreground, a figure on horseback is galloping, while other figures on horseback are scattered throughout the meadow. The brushstrokes are smooth, creating a soft ambiance. The color palette includes earthy greens, browns, and muted reds. The sky transitions from blues to pinkish hues, adding to the tranquil background.

artworks.title: Tawahquena Village
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image is viewed from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon line is positioned in the upper third of the image where trees meet the sky, with teepees nestled at the base. Delicate brushstrokes are used, particularly in the depiction of the sky, which blends blue and peach tones. The scene is painted in warm colors, with greens for the grass and trees, browns for the horses, and reds in the grass. There are figures near horses and open grasslands leading to trees and teepees in the distance.

artworks.title: Pawneepict Chief, Two Daughters, and a Warrior
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image displays four individuals standing side by side. Each person is standing upright, facing forward. The two figures on the left have long, dark hair, and the two on the right have shorter hair adorned with feathers. The individuals wear garments made of animal hides or traditional materials, with fur trimmings. Some of the clothing features decorative patterns, including one figure holding a long, decorated object that resembles a pipe. All four individuals wear necklaces, and one has armbands. The background is a blend of soft earth tones. The image is bordered by a tan frame.

artworks.title: Three Shoshonee Warriors
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing side by side outdoors. The person on the left wears a feather headdress and a fur wrap with colorful patterns, holding a bow and arrows. The middle person wears a feather headdress, a woolen cloak, patterned leggings, and moccasins. The person on the right wears feathers in their hair, a fur garment, and moccasins. The background is a simple, open plain with grass and a neutral sky.
